1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R585)
Native CLI Autocomplete, WeChat Studio, 3D Shorts & Procedural Art

• rostik32/zest (★64, MIT, Swift AppKit):
3MB binary, 20-30MB RAM, zero Electron/terminal proxy
1,500 Fig specs + Claude/Codex/Gemini CLI/Cursor/opencode
• Auto-generates specs from <tool> --help via zest gen + 74 themes
Q2: Closed-Loop WeChat Official Account Studio + AI Check?
• lqshow/dsh-wechat-studio (★6, MIT, DeepSeek Harness):
Paragraph-scoped revision + Tencent Zhuque AI detector API/PDF
6 covers + 8 animated SVG cards + 10x15 themes + Feishu relay
• Imports WeChat XLS metrics to distill reusable writing Skills
Q3: Code-Driven 60s 9:16 3D Cartoon Shorts with Cartesia?

2. End-to-End Enterprise Developer CLI & Generative Content Studio Architecture
Four-Pillar Workflow: Native zsh Popup ➔ WeChat Studio & Zhuque Loop ➔ Three.js 3D Shorts ➔ Canvas 2D Painterly Engine
Pillar A: Native macOS CLI Popup (rostik32/zest)
• Architecture: zsh plugin + Unix socket + native Swift AppKit popup
• Footprint: 3 MB app bundle, 20-30 MB RAM (vs 200-500 MB Electron)
• Built-In AI Specs: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor,
opencode, aider, Amp, goose + 1,500 converted Fig specs
• Dynamic Spec Gen: zest gen <tool> parses --help into ~/.config/zest
• Zero Terminal Proxy: Native compatibility with Ghostty, Kitty,
iTerm2, WezTerm, Alacritty, Terminal.app, VS Code & Cursor
✓ Replaces sluggish Electron wrappers & discontinued Fig agents
Pillar B: Closed-Loop WeChat Studio (dsh-wechat-studio)
• Paragraph-Scoped Editor: Click single paragraph to rewrite/verify
• Dual Zhuque AI Detection: Auto API check (SecretId/Key) or manual
PDF report upload that highlights high-AIGC sentences inline
• Visual Typesetting: 6 AI cover styles + 8 animated SVG card types
(click-expand, quiz, swipe, scratch, typewriter) + 10x15 palettes
• Publishing & Retro: Cloudinary Feishu relay + Official Draft push
+ XLS analytics import distilling top reads into persistent Skills
✓ End-to-end editorial closed loop from topic calendar to retrospective
Pillar C: Three.js 3D Shorts Skill (3d-video-studio)
• Format: 60s vertical 9:16 3D cartoon Shorts generated in code
• Dual Entry Modes: (1) Reference video timing & scene decomposition
or (2) Original topic script + character & scene bible synthesis
• Audio Lock: Cartesia TTS voiceover generation with exact scene
timestamp synchronization for lip, camera & physics cues
• Zero External 3D DCC: Pure Three.js geometry, shaders & lighting
rendered via headless browser + FFmpeg into MP4 deliverables
✓ Cuts 60s 3D vertical explainer production from days to 15 minutes
Pillar D: Procedural Canvas 2D Art (gemini-hydrogen-art)
• Engine: src/painter.js pure HTML5 Canvas 2D brush primitives
• Physical Media Simulation: Multi-pass colored-pencil hatching,
organic wobbly paths, dry-brush ink streaks & chalk stippling
• Surface Finish: Paper-tooth noise speckles + warm vignette washes
• Interactive Animation: 50-frame @ 10 FPS frame-scrubbable HTML
storybook scenes (sailor-and-octopus.html) with play/pause/step
• Zero External Assets: No PNGs, no WebGL shaders, no build bundler
✓ Deterministic Git-diffable hand-drawn illustrations & web animations
3. Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (CLAIM-20261120-R26-R585-ZEST-DSHWECHAT-3DVIDEOSTUDIO-HYDROGENART · 45 Engineers @ $100.00/h)
Path A: Commercial Terminal SaaS + Agency WeChat & 3D Video
• SaaS & Agency Fees: $3,260.00 / mo
• Overhead: 350MB Electron terminal bloat, manual WeChat HTML
copy-paste, slow 3D agency revisions & static raster asset drift
Path C: Hybrid OSS (zest + dsh-wechat + 3d-video + hydrogen)
• Compute & TTS/Detector APIs: $80.00 / mo
• Ops & Review Labor: 2.5 h/mo × $100.00/h = $250.00 / mo
• Outcome: 20-30MB native zsh popup, closed-loop WeChat studio,
Cartesia-synced Three.js 9:16 Shorts & zero-asset Canvas 2D art
